name: Denshanai de Now.
source: In the morning, on the train to school. The main character, Ryuhei Ishido, Witnesses a girl being molested by a thug. After briefly accessing the situation and seeing that no one was helping Ryuhei steps in to help the girl. The thug gets quickly dismissed by Ryuhei's Aikido skills and the incident ends safely with the girl thanking Ryuhei. However, later that night, A man accompanied by the thug from this morning appears and calls himself a Chikanshi and challenges Ryuhei to a Chikan game. The man also says that if Ryuhei refuses, He will stalk him around every day for 24 hours until he accepts. Although reluctant, Ryuhei responds to the man. Ryuhei takes a deep breath, Let the Chikan showdown begin!
translation: 早上，坐火车去学校。主角石户龙平目睹了一名女孩被暴徒猥亵。在简单了解情况​​后，看到没有人帮助龙平，便上前帮助女孩。暴徒很快被龙平的合气道技能驱散，事件以女孩感谢龙平而安全结束。然而，当天晚上晚些时候，一名与今早暴徒同行的男子出现，自称赤坎西，并向龙平发起赤坎游戏挑战。该男子还表示，如果龙平拒绝，他将每天24小时跟踪他，直到他接受为止。尽管不情愿，龙平还是回应了这个男人。龙平深吸一口气，赤坎对决开始吧！
